messages.semantic.strong_clean: Strong timing with supportive execution conditions.
messages.semantic.strong_selective: Opportunity is strong, but act selectively.
messages.semantic.strong_restrained: Timing is strong. Keep execution restrained.
messages.semantic.weak_defensive: Timing is weaker. Protect position and reduce avoidable risk.
messages.semantic.review_focus: Better suited to review and refinement than a major push.
messages.semantic.mixed_conflict: Signals conflict. This day is not uniformly favorable or unfavorable.
messages.semantic.insufficient: Not enough evidence for a reliable decision posture.
messages.semantic.uncertain: Timing and execution conditions do not point in one clear direction.
messages.semantic.posture_high_leverage: Strong timing with supportive execution conditions.
messages.semantic.posture_build: Good for steady progress and preparation.
messages.semantic.posture_selective: Opportunity is present, but act selectively.
messages.semantic.posture_review: Better suited to review and refinement than a major push.
messages.semantic.posture_defensive: Protect position and reduce avoidable risk.
messages.semantic.posture_recovery: Favor recovery, consolidation, and lower-pressure progress.
messages.semantic.posture_mixed: Signals conflict. This day is not uniformly favorable or unfavorable.
messages.semantic.posture_insufficient: Not enough evidence for a reliable decision posture.
messages.semantic.material_tradeoff: {higher_score_option} has stronger timing, while {cleaner_posture_option} offers cleaner execution. This is a trade-off rather than a clear winner.
messages.semantic.near_tie_cleaner_posture: Timing strength is very close. Execution conditions favor {option}.
messages.semantic.compare_aligned: Timing strength and execution conditions point in the same direction.
messages.semantic.score_advantage_with_caution: {higher_score_option} has stronger timing, with more constrained execution conditions.
messages.semantic.no_definitive_better: This is a trade-off rather than a clear winner.
messages.semantic.window_mixed_posture: This window mixes forward and more restrictive days.
messages.semantic.window_insufficient: This window does not have enough evidence for a reliable posture.
messages.semantic.window_contains_forward_and_res: High-score window contains both forward and restrictive days.
messages.semantic.high_clarity: Information quality or decision clarity is stronger.
messages.semantic.low_clarity: Information quality or decision clarity is weaker.
messages.semantic.high_reversibility_safety: Decisions are easier to reverse or adjust.
messages.semantic.low_reversibility_safety: Decisions are harder to reverse. Keep options open.
messages.semantic.same_dimension_conflict: The same factor both supports and cautions.
messages.semantic.veto_present: A strong caution limits how far to push.
messages.semantic.no_outcome_prediction: Timing signals cannot determine the factual outcome.
messages.semantic.high_stakes_review_required: Use timing as a planning aid. Verify the decision against real-world evidence and professional requirements.
messages.semantic.deadline_priority: Do not delay a factual deadline because of timing signals.
